svg.title: F-06: Quick-Reference Disease Identification Matrix — Common Cattle Diseases in Tropical Systems
svg.desc: Matrix showing 10 common cattle diseases as rows and 8 key symptoms as columns. Each cell indicates whether the symptom is a primary sign, secondary sign, absent, or a key differentiator for that disease. Includes urgency level and notifiable status.
svg.text: F-06 — Disease symptom matrix · tropical cattle quick reference
● Primary sign ◐ Often present ○ Possible — Absent / not typical ★ Key differentiator
Hot swollen quarter, clots in milk
Figure F-06 · For notifiable diseases (FMD, Rabies, Brucellosis): isolate, stop movement, call national authority before treating
See ch-07 for DARTER assessment protocol · ch-15 for notifiable disease reporting · ch-25 for full clinical profiles
Notifiable disease — legal obligation to report to animal health authority
